summary.key_theme: Meta 積極投入 AI 基礎設施導致資本支出激增與信用評級展望下調，但其廣告業務成長與債券融資計畫仍吸引市場關注。

bullish.title: As Big Tech Sheds Billions, Meta (META) Signals a Top Buying Opportunity
bullish.reason: 分析師將 Meta 列為未來 5 年最佳科技股之一，認為當前股價回調提供了良好的買入機會。

bullish.title: Why AI is boosting Meta's ad business while hurting Google search
bullish.reason: Meta 的 AI 應用成功推動廣告營收成長，表現優於 Google 搜尋業務，顯示其 AI 變現能力強勁。

bullish.title: Williams Cos. Shrugs Off AI Data Center Jitters With Power Generation Ambitions
bullish.reason: Williams Cos. 與 Meta 簽署 400 兆瓦電力合約，證明 Meta 在 AI 資料中心基礎設施布局的實質進展。

bullish.title: Meta Platforms (META) Sees $140.6 Million in Net ETF Buying on Oct. 30
bullish.reason: ETF 市場出現 1.4 億美元的淨買入，顯示機構投資人對該股的長期信心。

bullish.title: Investors Are Beginning to Say That Meta Is The Best Buy And Hold Stock Through 2030
bullish.reason: 儘管面臨法律與監管壓力，市場仍看好其廣告業務的長期複利效應。

bullish.title: Meta Stocks Gain as Preferred Issue Implies $812.5 Million Annual Dividends
bullish.reason: 優先股發行帶來的股利承諾吸引了部分追求收益的投資人。

bearish.title: As Meta Stock Suffers Its Worst Month in Years, S&P Delivers a Brutal $39 Billion Cash Flow Warning
bearish.reason: 標普將 Meta 信用展望從「穩定」下調至「負面」，主因是龐大的 AI 資本支出嚴重侵蝕自由現金流。

bearish.title: Top VC Warns: “Depreciation Is Going to Start Hitting” Microsoft, Google and Meta
bearish.reason: 創投專家警告 AI 資本支出過高，未來折舊費用將對財報獲利能力造成顯著壓力。

bearish.title: Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) Is Spending Billions on AI: Will the Bet Pay Off?
bearish.reason: 市場對於 Meta 投入數十億美元於 AI 的投資回報率（ROI）存有高度疑慮。

bearish.title: Meta Reportedly Plans To Raise $20B From Its Cross-Border Bond Sales
bearish.reason: Meta 尋求發行至少 200 億美元債券，反映出公司現金流壓力，需透過舉債支撐 AI 擴張。

bearish.title: META Q3 Earnings Call Put Spotlight on Muse Growth and AI Spending
bearish.reason: 財報顯示基礎設施成本持續上升，抵銷了部分 Muse AI 採用帶來的正面效益。

bearish.title: Nvidia “Owns the Bank”, and Things Are About to Get Interesting
bearish.reason: 報導指出 Meta 參與 250 億美元股票銷售計畫，顯示其對外部資金的高度依賴。

bearish.title: Meta works to increase clout with Democrats ahead of midterms
bearish.reason: Meta 試圖在期中選舉前加強與民主黨的關係，反映出公司面臨的監管壓力與政治風險。

bearish.title: People Moves: Mercer Advisors Hires Wealth.com, Meta Alum as VP of Data
bearish.reason: Meta 前員工離職轉任他職，雖屬常態，但顯示人才流動對公司內部穩定性的潛在影響。

neutral.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq Recover From AI Rout On US Midterm Election Day
neutral.reason: Meta 股價隨大盤波動，主要受期中選舉與整體科技股情緒影響，非公司單一因素。

neutral.title: Top Midday Stories: Apple Fiscal Q4 EPS, Revenue Top Estimates, Shares Fall; Meta Reportedly Targeting Up to $25 Billion in Bond Sale
neutral.reason: 綜合性市場報導，提及 Meta 債券發行計畫，未對股價產生直接影響。

neutral.title: Apple Retreats 4% Despite Earnings Beat as Memory Costs Squeeze Margin Outlook; Microsoft Dips, Meta Holds Steady
neutral.reason: 比較同業表現，Meta 股價相對持平，無顯著利多或利空訊息。

neutral.title: A Disappointing IPO Didn't Stop Meta Platforms: Here's Why That Matters for the Anthropic IPO
neutral.reason: 以 Meta 過去 IPO 經驗作為 Anthropic IPO 的參考，對 Meta 當前股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Meta seeks at least $20 billion in bond sale as AI debt boom accelerates
neutral.reason: 重複報導債券發行計畫，內容與其他新聞重疊，故列為中性參考。

neutral.title: AI Data Center Jitters Aren’t Slowing Williams’ Power Generation Ambitions
neutral.reason: 重複報導 Williams Cos. 與 Meta 的電力合約，內容與前述新聞一致。
